intent: An inline single-select choice card for an agent response: pick one lettered option and it highlights in place.
guidance: Use it for one small inline decision inside an agent response — a set of lettered options with one active at a time. Bind selected/onSelect to control the pick from the host; omit selected and it tracks its own internal state. The choices are toggle buttons (aria-pressed), not a radiogroup, so it reads as a row of press states rather than a strict single-choice group; if you need real radio semantics, reach for a RadioGroup instead. Pass short letter values (the badge sizes for one glyph) and one-line labels. Selecting paints the row with the selected background, fills the letter badge with the brand color, and deepens the label from secondary to primary text.

anatomy.description: Full-width rounded-c-lg container with an inset c-border ring; clips its contents.
The prompt text row at the top of the card.
Vertical stack of option buttons below the question.
Full-width row per option; sets aria-pressed and highlights when it is the selected letter.
22px square holding the option's letter; fills with c-bg-brand when active, otherwise shows a c-border ring.
The option's one-line description beside the badge.

use_when: Offering a small set of lettered options for one inline decision in an agent response.
You want the chosen option to highlight in place without leaving the card.
dont_use_when: You need strict single-select semantics for mutually exclusive options — use a RadioGroup.
More than one option can be chosen at once — use Checkboxes.

tokens.note: Spacing (px-[12px]/py-[8px], gap-[2px], p-[4px]), badge size (size-[22px]), and type (text-[13px]/[11px], leading-[22px]/[20px]/[16px], font-[550]/[450], tracking-[-0.032px]/[0.055px]) are hardcoded arbitrary Tailwind values, not tokens; font family via var(--composa-font-family).

a11y.role: No wrapper role; each choice is a native <button type="button">.
a11y.selection: aria-pressed on each button reflects the active letter (toggle-button semantics, not a radiogroup).
a11y.focus: focus-visible ring via c-focus-ring; outline-none otherwise.

code.example:
<MultiChoiceCard
  question="Which layout do you want?"
  choices={[
    { letter: 'A', label: 'Single column' },
    { letter: 'B', label: 'Two columns' },
  ]}
  selected={choice}
  onSelect={setChoice}
/>
